第71章 周处邀约，大戏开场-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

次日。

震旦国际大楼。八点零三分。

林川到的时候，前台刚开灯。

办公桌上码着五份合同，封面贴着彩色标签。

林川坐下来，拧开笔帽，翻开第一份。

芯海微电子扩产项目。

二期实验室入驻张江三号研发楼，面积扩至一千二百平，

九州创投追加投资并锁定优先退出权。

翻页。条款没问题。签字。

第二份。深圳迁入的工业软件公司“数智云”，整体搬迁至张江，

九州创投占股百分之十八，对赌条款绑定三年营收增长率。

第三份、第四份，两家无线增值服务商的入驻协议。

林川在其中一份的排他条款上用红笔划了一道，批注四个字：“范围收窄。”

九点二十八分。五份合同全部盖章完毕。

叶知秋进来收合同的时候，林川已经在看下一沓文件了。

“法务跟着一起去，当面签完原件带回来存档。”

“明白。”叶知秋把合同装进文件袋，转身走了两步，又回头笑着说道。

“对了，跟您说一声。张总监昨晚在办公室待到凌晨一点，把成渝昆三个节点的数据包全翻完了。”

”标注了四十多个不懂的问题，列了个清单，今早七点就来了。刚才我路过的时候，他搬了把椅子坐在周明远工位旁边，一条一条地问。”

她停了一下。

“周明远说他从没见过哪个总监级别的人，拿着笔记本像大一新生一样记笔记。”

林川嘴角动了一下。

“让他该问就问，别怕丢面子。跑业务的人不需要什么都懂，但需要知道自己不懂什么。”

“好。”

叶知秋带着许嘉宁出了门。

办公室安静下来。

林川靠回椅背，目光落在桌面上那五份合同留下的压痕上。

五家企业，覆盖芯片、软件、通信、原材料四条线。

张江核心区块的产业生态密度又往上拧了一扣。

跟齐衡合作是合作，九州创投最大的护城河还是这些项目产业。

手机在桌面上震了一下。

林川拿起来看了一眼。

*夏若冰*

短信只有一行字——

*“昨天谢谢你。很久没那么放松地跟人吃过饭了。”

林川看了两秒，拇指在键盘上敲了四个字。

The next day.

Aurora International Building.8:03.

When Lin Chuan arrived, the lights had just been turned on at the front desk.

Five contracts are stacked on the desk, with colorful labels on the covers.

Lin Chuan sat down, unscrewed the cap of his pen, and opened the first copy.

Chipsea Microelectronics production expansion project.

The second phase of the laboratory is located in Zhangjiang No. 3 R&D Building, with the area expanded to 1,200 square meters.

Jiuzhou Venture Capital made additional investments and locked in priority exit rights.

Turn the page.Terms are okay.signature.

Second copy."Digital Cloud", an industrial software company that moved into Shenzhen, moved its entirety to Zhangjiang.

Jiuzhou Venture Capital holds 18% of the shares, and the betting terms are bound to the three-year revenue growth rate.

The third and fourth are the settlement agreements of two wireless value-added service providers.

Lin Chuan used a red pen to draw a line on one of the exclusivity clauses and annotated four words: "Narrowed scope."

Nine twenty-eight.All five contracts have been sealed.

When Ye Zhiqiu came in to collect the contract, Lin Chuan was already looking at the next stack of documents.

"The legal affairs department will go with you and sign the original documents in person and bring them back for archiving."

"Understood." Ye Zhiqiu put the contract into the document bag, turned around and took two steps, then turned back and said with a smile.

"By the way, let me tell you. Director Zhang stayed in the office until one o'clock in the morning last night and went through all the data packets of the three nodes of Cheng, Yu, and Kun."

"I marked more than 40 questions that I didn't understand, made a list, and came here at seven o'clock this morning. When I passed by just now, he moved a chair and sat next to Zhou Mingyuan's workstation, asking questions one by one."

She paused.

"Zhou Mingyuan said that he had never seen anyone at the director level holding a notebook and taking notes like a freshman."

Lin Chuan's mouth moved.

"Let him ask what he needs to ask, and don't be afraid of losing face. Business people don't need to know everything, but they need to know what they don't know."

"Okay."

Ye Zhiqiu took Xu Jianing out.

The office fell silent.

Lin Chuan leaned back in his chair and his eyes fell on the indentations left by the five contracts on the table.

Five companies, covering four lines: chips, software, communications, and raw materials.

The industrial ecological density in the core area of ​​Zhangjiang has increased again.

Cooperation with Qiheng is cooperation, and the biggest moat of Jiuzhou Venture Capital is these project industries.

The phone vibrated on the table.

Lin Chuan picked it up and took a look.

*Xia Ruobing*

The text message only has one line——

* "Thank you for yesterday. It's been a long time since I had a meal with someone so relaxed."

Lin Chuan looked at it for two seconds and typed four words on the keyboard with his thumb.
